volumeRun.roundSize: 0.1 USDC buy, sell back exactly the DM received
volumeRun.txsNote: 200 logged txs + 1 unreported round-61 sell (CLI reported failure but the sell landed; the recovery sold the same DM twice — both sells verified via Swap events). Pool Swap events all-time: 203 (101 buys + 102 sells, incl. the 2-tx test round).
volumeRun.dmDeltaNote: Round-61 double-sell sold 98.36 DM from the wallet's 99.9T holdings (not from a round buy). Every wei accounted for; see the jsonl anomaly note + circle-stack-2026-11-16.md.
volumeRun.incidents: VM reboot mid-round-8 (buy landed, sell never ran — reconciled exactly + sold back, run resumed at round 9); round-61 double-sell (see dmDeltaNote). Runner fixed after the run: failed writes now re-check on-chain state before any retry.
